expertise.title: What I bring.
expertise.card1_p: Custom automations and AI agents. Repetitive tasks run themselves. Your team refocuses on what truly matters.
expertise.card2_p: Make your offer visible, test a market fast, structure and scale your outreach. Systems that generate activity at every stage of your growth.
expertise.card3_p: Problem identification and prioritization, strategy definition, solution design, roadmap and development. From framing to production.
expertise.card4_p: 3 years as Data PM at Decathlon building indicators for marketing teams across 60+ countries. Knowing what to measure, how to track it, and what to do with it.

projets.title: Completed projects.
projets.autorise_desc: I amplify the impact of organizations changing the world. With intelligence and automation.
projets.lagun_desc: An AI that engages you in Basque conversations and corrects you with kindness. Available on Telegram.
projets.m1_desc: Automated outreach for climate-innovation companies. Personas, enriched campaigns, centralized responses and engagement scoring.
projets.m1_result: Every qualified prospect followed up — none forgotten.
projets.m2_desc: Tens of thousands of researchers identified for climate innovation — directly reachable for an innovation call.
projets.m2_result: A pool of tens of thousands of researchers, ready to activate.
projets.m3_desc: Target company identification via satellite imagery (rooftops), geo data (building height) and automated decision-maker sourcing.
projets.m3_result: Sales reps only talk to eligible prospects.
projets.m4_desc: Monitoring selected topics and sources to generate LinkedIn posts matching the executive's style and voice. One-click publishing from their inbox.
projets.m5_desc: After the General Meeting, automatic drafting of account approvals, privacy declarations and powers of attorney. Sent, followed up for signature and filed — no manual intervention.
projets.m5_result: Zero copy-paste, zero chasing, zero manual upload.
projets.m6_desc: Smart email triage, daily summaries and pre-generated drafts. Inboxes under control, noise-free, for a small team.
projets.m6_result: An inbox that no longer needs arbitration.
projets.m7_desc: RAG vector base trained solely on internal data. Ultra-reactive, relevant first-level responses — guaranteed hallucination-free.
projets.m7_result: Instant response, support team refocused on what matters.
projets.m8_desc: Two AI agents grade in parallel, fully independently from the teacher, to surface scoring gaps between comparable papers — fatigue and mood excluded.
projets.m8_result: Fair grading — student by student, paper by paper.

apropos.title: About.
apropos.quote1: Three years at Decathlon designing data systems for marketing teams across 60 countries. I came away with an obsession: build things that are reliable, useful, and never lose sight of what they're for.
apropos.quote2: I don't build tech for tech's sake. Same with AI. What drives me is your mission — what you'll teach me about your business, and how I can help you operate more efficiently.

footer.desc: Passionate about trail running, I know you can't go the distance by sprinting head-down. I work in short cycles and only commit to what I can deliver fast.
